schema: LAISE TUK2 Structural & Masking Map v1.0

masking_model.formula: temporal overlap ? spectral overlap ? level similarity support ? envelope similarity support
masking_model.epistemic_limit: Engineering masking-risk proxy, not human intelligibility probability.

lead_vocal.reason: Primary intelligibility reference. Allow adaptive low/moderate motion, preserve audibility.

drums.reason: Preserve attack and rhythmic reference; limited movement.

keyboards.reason: Strong side dominance / negative L-R correlation measured.

other.reason: Wide and partially anticorrelated source; content identity not assumed.
